name: Are my files uploaded to a server when merging?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. PDFree merges PDF files entirely in your browser using pdf-lib. Your files never leave your device and are never sent to any server.

name: Is there a file size limit for merging PDFs?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are no artificial paywall limits. PDFree processes files locally in your browser — no subscription required. For the best experience, keep the total batch under 300 MB; larger batches may be slower on low-memory devices.

name: Can I merge more than two PDFs at once?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can merge unlimited PDF files in one operation. Just add all the files you want to combine — 2, 10, 50, or 100+.
Yes. PDFree is a Progressive Web App (PWA). Once loaded, it works fully offline — no internet connection required for processing.

name: Is there a daily limit on how many merges I can do?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. PDFree has no daily usage cap. Merge as many PDFs as you want, as often as you need — no task limits, no file count limits.

name: Can I merge PDFs on a phone or tablet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. PDFree works in mobile browsers — Chrome for Android and Safari for iOS. File selection uses the native file picker, and you can reorder files using the on-screen buttons.
